name: solr
title: Solr
description: Perform operations against Apache Lucene Solr.
label: search,monitoring

properties.name: host
properties.description: The solr instance host name (set to 'default' to use the host name defined on component level)

properties.name: port
properties.description: The solr instance port number

properties.name: basePath
properties.description: The solr instance base path (usually /solr)

properties.name: async
properties.description: Use async request processing (when supported by the solr client)

properties.name: autoCommit
properties.description: If true, each producer insert/delete operation will be automatically performing a commit

properties.name: collection
properties.description: The name of the collection to act against

properties.name: connectionTimeout
properties.description: The time in ms to wait before connection will time out.

properties.name: deleteByQuery
properties.description: For the delete instruction, interprete body as query/queries instead of id/ids.

properties.name: from
properties.description: Starting index of the response.

properties.name: operation
properties.description: What operation to perform

properties.name: requestHandler
properties.description: The path of the update request handler (use for update requests / set solr parameter qt for search requests)

properties.name: requestTimeout
properties.description: The time in ms to wait before the request will time out (former soTimeout).

properties.name: size
properties.description: Size of the response.

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: solrClient
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: The solr client to connect to solr. When solrClient bean is provided, all connection properties will be used from that solrClient (host, port, username, password, connectionTimeout, requestTimeout, enableSSL, ...). When not explicitly configured, camel uses the HttpJdkSolrClient.

properties.name: certificatePath
properties.label: security
properties.description: The certificate that can be used to access the solr host. It can be loaded by default from classpath, but you can prefix with classpath:, file:, or http: to load the resource from different systems.

properties.name: enableSSL
properties.label: security
properties.description: Enable SSL

properties.name: password
properties.label: security
properties.description: Password for authenticating

properties.name: sslContextParameters
properties.label: security
properties.description: To configure security using SSLContextParameters. When configured, this takes precedence over the certificatePath option. This allows configuring named groups, signature schemes, cipher suites, and protocols for the TLS connection.

properties.name: username
properties.label: security
properties.description: Basic authenticate user
